## Average Bill Length of Each Species 

```{r}
penguinsdt |>
  drop_na(bill_length_mm) |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(meanlength = mean(bill_length_mm))
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  penguinsdt, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point() 

```
